BLUEPEARL CARROLLWOOD FAMILIES:
Our Carrollwood and Tampa hospitals have united and will be serving you at our Tampa location! Our trusted team will continue to provide the same care you’ve come to expect.
We are committed to making this transition as smooth as possible for you and your pets. If you have any questions or need assistance with your pet’s medical records, please contact us.
Thank you for your continued trust and support—we look forward to continuing to care for your pets at our Tampa hospital.
BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Tampa Bay.
We are located near the corner of Busch Boulevard and Dale Mabry Highway in Tampa, serving pets and their families in the entire Tampa Bay area, including the communities of Seffner, Palm Harbor, Oldsmar, New Port Richey, Holiday, Lakeland, Winter Haven, Spring Hill and Brooksville.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care 24/7 in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.
Learn more about your emergency visit
.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.
See Specialties and Services

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Tampa.
Our 16,000 square-foot, state-of-the-art Tampa pet hospital has the equipment and staff to give your pets the advanced emergency and specialty medical care they deserve.
We offer an intensive care unit, a CT scanner, MRI, a linear accelerator, x-rays, ultrasound, fluoroscopy and endoscopy.
We also offer radioactive iodine treatment for cats with hyperthyroidism. We are fully equipped to serve as your 24-hour emergency veterinarian – and we even have a blood bank on site.

“Thank you, Dr. Yee and the entire BluePearl team, for everything you’ve done for Sheldon and for us. Your dedication to your patients and their families is truly remarkable.”
–Anais K.
“Juneau was brought to BluePearl with suspected tetanus. When admitted, she was given a diagnosis of stage 2 (later advancing to stage 4) with a 50% survival rate. Juneau was some of the staffs’ first case of tetanus since it is so rare in the United States.
She was in the hospital for a little under two weeks. There were a lot of tears, hard decisions, hospital visits, and little glimpses of hope around every corner. The vets and support staff adapted to the situation, did the necessary research and came up with a plan to give Juneau the best care possible.
Juneau’s survival was a true miracle and we have BluePearl and June’s perseverance to thank for it!”
–Jordan M.
